sources.notes: Fetched (found via the 'Interview' link on https://www.ncl.ac.uk/student-progress/visa/). Verbatim: 'As part of Newcastle University's obligations to UK immigration compliance, the University reserves the right to carry out additional checks on applicants' eligibility for student visa sponsorship.' Applicants may be asked to take 'a brief interview' covering the four listed topics. Process: 'Sign and return the Consent form' to compliance@ncl.ac.uk, then 'Use this booking form' (Microsoft Bookings page named 'Credibilityinterview'). Live booked interview with the compliance team; no CAS Shield/Enroly mention; no example questions.
